heading: Clearer agent connection errors and shortcut settings
summary: Agents use the host keys you already trusted and report why a connection failed. Shortcuts are easier to change, and the authentication rules are easier to read.
changes: Trusted host keys work for agents
An agent connects with the host keys you already trusted in PromeFTP instead of reporting an unknown key.
A failed connection reports the cause, such as a wrong key, a changed host key, a refused connection, or a DNS failure, with a short hint.
Permission presets, including an allow-everything preset, speed up granting a bookmark. Access stays limited to the scope you choose.
Every shortcut can be changed, and a key check shows what your keyboard sends. Default shortcuts are unchanged.
Rules and saved answers are listed by host, and the rule editor is redesigned.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
